title: decisions.json - input of curation adjudicate-apply (schema 1.0)
description: The Daemon exports this task's decisions that are not applied yet (D32: decisions never cross tasks). Lines and decisions follow v1 (design doc 06, section 5.1): label = annotation conflict from skill_profile, task_verdict = task_success abstention, reject_appeal = appeal of a reject attributed to task_success. 'discard' (drop the whole episode) wins over any task verdict; 'unsure' is recorded and changes nothing.

relabel_rerun.description: how relabelled episodes without a human task verdict are judged again (D39): v1 = what v1's rejudge runs (multi-view scoring and the per-camera end-state vote only); full = the first run's complete task_success flow. Recorded with each relabel it applies, so a later retry of those episodes judges them the same way
